_rule: External research says what the wider ecosystem does. It never overrides own-account analytics; disagreements are recorded.

findings.claim: Diwali 2026 falls on Sunday 8 November 2026 (Lakshmi Puja), with the five-day festival running 6-10 November; Dhanteras is 6 November and Bhai Dooj 10 November.
findings.source: Airalo festival calendar; Old Farmer's Almanac

findings.claim: The week of 2026-10-19 sits in the gap between Dussehra (20 Oct) and Diwali (8 Nov): families travel home mid-festival-window, exams and result announcements cluster here, and train tickets for the Diwali rush are already sold out weeks ahead.
findings.source: Inferred from Diwali 2026 dates plus Indian Railways 120-day booking pattern

findings.claim: A Times of India survey (14 Oct 2026) finds young Indians constantly connected online still struggle to form meaningful relationships; demanding work schedules and exhaustion leave digital interactions that do not translate into closeness offline.
findings.source: Times of India relationships survey coverage (14 Oct 2026)

findings.claim: An Oct 2026 survey of Indian singles reports 58% feel completely lonely in real life despite mingling online, and 55% are too tired after work to meet anyone; 40% use dating apps.
findings.source: Asianet Newsable summarising an Indian singles loneliness survey (5 Oct 2026)

findings.claim: For Reels in 2026 the top ranking signals are watch time and sends per reach (DM shares); reels built to be sent to a friend outperform reels built to be liked, and 30-90 second storytelling holds watch time best.
findings.source: Buffer Instagram algorithm guide (14 Oct 2026); Metricool Reels guide (21 Sep 2026)

opportunities: Festival-window belonging pain: being away from family or left out of friend-group plans while everyone posts celebrations; keep topics universal, never festival-specific.
Result/anxiety season: exam and job outcomes land mid-week for Indian students and young professionals.
Loneliness-in-a-crowd angle matches the Oct 2026 India surveys directly and fits the account's sad/confession register.
disagreements_with_account_data: External guides push 15-30s quick hooks, but own-account analytics favour 70-80s one_pushback storytelling; own data wins, no change.
